item.name: Cinderwheel
item.entry:
The Cinderwheel is Fogport’s dangerous one-wheeled racing machine: a massive iron-rimmed wheel surrounding a compact steam engine, boiler, fuel tank, and exposed drive machinery.

Unlike a Cinderhack, which is built to carry passengers, a Cinderwheel is built to go fast, turn sharply, and survive impacts that would destroy an ordinary vehicle. Its driver sits forward of the central hub while a second rider, the stoker, stands on a reinforced rear platform to feed the boiler, make repairs, and defend the machine from competitors.

Cinderwheels are loud, unstable, soot-blackened, and difficult to control. Their narrow profile can cut through gaps no Cinderhack could enter, but a bad turn may send the entire machine rolling across the track. Most carry steering bars, pressure gauges, emergency tools, armored boiler plates, a forward ram, and enough handholds to keep a stoker from meeting the turning wheel too personally.

Racing Machines

Cinderwheels are primarily associated with the Cinderwheel Rally, Fogport’s annual endurance race around Saint Orra’s Colossus in Lastlight. The finest machines are named, numbered, and repeatedly rebuilt; a champion Cinderwheel may be more famous than its riders. A failed racer is stripped for parts, sold to an enthusiast, or rebuilt into next year’s trouble.

Most Fogporters consider Cinderwheels ridiculous, dangerous, and impossible to resist watching.
